ImageDescription.value:
Raymond ordered a 黑椒牛肉饭 Black Pepper Beef on rice and HY got a 腐乳五花肉面 Belly Pork in Fermented Beancurd Sauce with Noodles. Both had decent sauces.

Julia's 茶树菇排骨面 Mushroom and Pork Rib Stew with noodles was also ok, and so was my 糖醋鱼片饭 Sweet and Sour Fish on rice. They left the skin on the trevally, which might be a bit fishy for some, but it does help to hold the fish together.

We also got some 小龙包 Xiao Long Bao dumplings to share.
